sentences.en: Part A To make political decisions about the extent and type of forestry in a region it is important to understand the consequences of those decisions.
sentences.zh: A部分作出关于一个区域林业的范围和类型的政治决定,必须了解这些决定的后果。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: One tool for assessing the impact of forestry on the ecosystem is population viability analysis (PVA).
sentences.zh: 评估林业对生态系统影响的一个工具是人口生存能力分析。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This is a tool for predicting the probability that a species will become extinct in a particular region over a specific period.
sentences.zh: 这是一个工具,用来预测某一物种在某一特定时期内在某一区域灭绝的概率。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: It has been successfully used in the United States to provide input into resource exploitation decisions and assist wildlife managers and there is now enormous potential for using population viability to assist wildlife management in Australia’s forests.
sentences.zh: 美国成功地利用了这一工具,为资源开发决策提供投入,并协助野生动物管理者,现在利用人口生存能力协助澳大利亚森林中的野生动物管理的潜力很大。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: A species becomes extinct when the last individual dies.
sentences.zh: 物种在最后一个人死亡时灭绝。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: This observation is a useful starting point for any discussion of extinction as it highlights the role of luck and chance in the extinction process.
sentences.zh: 这一看法是讨论灭绝问题的有益起点,因为它突出了运气和机会在灭绝过程中的作用。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: To make a prediction about extinction we need to understand the processes that can contribute to it and these fall into four broad categories which are discussed below.
sentences.zh: 为了预测灭绝现象,我们需要了解有助于灭绝的过程,这些过程分为四大类,下文将讨论这些大类。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Part B A Early attempts to predict population viability were based on demographic uncertainty Whether an individual survives from one year to the next will largely be a matter of chance.
sentences.zh: B A部分早期预测人口生存能力的尝试是基于人口不确定性,一个人是否从一年到下一年生存,在很大程度上是一个机会问题。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Some pairs may produce several young in a single year while others may produce none in that same year.
sentences.zh: 有些对子在一年中可能生产出几个年青的,而另一些对子在同一年可能没有生产。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Small populations will fluctuate enormously because of the random nature of birth and death and these chance fluctuations can cause species extinctions even if, on average, the population size should increase.
sentences.zh: 由于出生和死亡的随机性质,人口数量将大幅波动,这种机会波动即使平均人口数量应增加,也可能造成物种灭绝。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Taking only this uncertainty of ability to reproduce into account, extinction is unlikely if the number of individuals in a population is above about 50 and the population is growing.
sentences.zh: 仅考虑到这种生育能力的不确定性,如果人口中的人数超过50人,人口在增加,那么灭绝的可能性就不大。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: B Small populations cannot avoid a certain amount of inbreeding.
sentences.zh: B 人口少,不能避免一定数量的亲子关系。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This is particularly true if there is a very small number of one sex.
sentences.zh: 如果只有极少数的性别,情况尤其如此。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: For example, if there are only 20 individuals of a species and only one is a male, all future individuals in the species must be descended from that one male.
sentences.zh: 例如,如果一个物种只有20个个体,只有一个是男性,那么该物种中今后的所有个体都必须从一个男性中降生。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: For most animal species such individuals are less likely to survive and reproduce.
sentences.zh: 对于大多数动物物种来说,这类个人生存和繁殖的可能性较小。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Inbreeding increases the chance of extinction.
sentences.zh: 世袭增加灭绝的可能性

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: C Variation within a species is the raw material upon which natural selection acts.
sentences.zh: 物种内部的变异是自然选择行为所依据的原材料。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Without genetic variability a species lacks the capacity to evolve and cannot adapt to changes in its environment or to new predators and new diseases.
sentences.zh: 如果没有遗传变异,物种就缺乏进化能力,无法适应环境的变化或新的掠食动物和新疾病。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The loss of genetic diversity associated with reductions in population size will contribute to the likelihood of extinction.
sentences.zh: 人口规模减少导致遗传多样性丧失,这将导致灭绝的可能性。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: D Recent research has shown that other factors need to be considered.
sentences.zh: D 最近的研究显示,其他因素需要加以考虑。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Australia’s environment fluctuates enormously from year to year.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚的环境每年都波动很大。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: These fluctuations add yet another degree of uncertainty to the survival of many species.
sentences.zh: 这些波动又给许多物种的生存增加了一种不确定因素。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Catastrophes such as fire, flood, drought or epidemic may reduce population sizes to a small fraction of their average level.
sentences.zh: 火灾、洪水、干旱或流行病等灾害可能会将人口规模减少到平均水平的一小部分。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: When allowance is made for these two additional elements of uncertainty the population size necessary to be confident of persistence for a few hundred years may increase to several thousand.
sentences.zh: 如果考虑到这两个不确定因素,相信坚持几百年所需的人口规模可能增加到几千人。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Part C Beside these processes we need to bear in mind the distribution of a population.
sentences.zh: 除了这些进程之外,我们需要铭记人口分布。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: A species that occurs in five isolated places each containing 20 individuals will not have the same probability of extinction as a species with a single population of 100 individuals in a single locality.
sentences.zh: 在一个五个孤立地点发生的物种,每个物种共20人,其灭绝概率与一个单一地点的单一种群100人物种不同。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Where logging occurs (that is, the cutting down of forests for timber) forest dependent creatures in that area will be forced to leave.
sentences.zh: 如果伐木(即砍伐木材用森林),该地区依赖森林的生物将被迫离开。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Ground-dwelling herbivores may return within a decade.
sentences.zh: 地底栖植物在十年内可能返回

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: However, arboreal marsupials (that is animals which live in trees) may not recover to pre-logging densities for over a century.
sentences.zh: 然而,一个多世纪以来,Arboreal的动物(即生活在树木中的动物)可能无法恢复到登山前的密度。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: As more forests are logged, animal population sizes will be reduced further.
sentences.zh: 随着森林的砍伐,动物人口规模将进一步缩小。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Regardless of the theory or model that we choose, a reduction in population size decreases the genetic diversity of a population and increases the probability of extinction because of any or all of the processes listed above.
sentences.zh: 无论我们选择何种理论或模式,人口规模的缩小都会降低人口的遗传多样性,并增加因上述任何或所有过程而灭绝的可能性。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: It is therefore a scientific fact that increasing the area that is loaded in any region will increase the probability that forest-dependent animals will become extinct.
sentences.zh: 因此,科学事实是,增加任何区域装载面积将增加依赖森林的动物灭绝的可能性。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

PVA has been used in Australia for many years.

Extinction is a naturally occurring phenomenon.
